mission.title: Exhaustive rational transfer spectra
mission.statement: Construct nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on R⁴ for every compact simple gauge group and prove a strictly positive mass gap.
mission.brief: Enumerate every multiset of up to four positive excited weights on each denominator grid 4 through 35 and test the sharp time-doubling inequality exactly.
mission.author: Deep Bhattacharjee
sources: Wilson cluster and conditional entropy constructions
gaps: Prove the same-coupling weak-coupling thermal-defect bound on the full rectangular window.
Bound the separated-seam connected response after summing spatial sites, uniformly along the tuned Wilson cutoff family.
Match the continuum construction and finite-cutoff transfer estimates on one family.
Control neutral states and all required gauge groups.

examples: Denominator 4: exhausted 34 spectra, with 3 in the small-defect range and 3 attaining the bound.
Denominator 5: exhausted 69 spectra, with 5 in the small-defect range and 4 attaining the bound.
